name: IWI Tavor X95/X95-R Rifle
description_html:
This is a authorized rework of IWI X95 Rifle mod posted on sns.oddba.cn

Only tested on 3.8.0, should work on 3.8.3.

The mod includes two types of X95, the original Tavor X95 and the X95-R chambered in 5.45x39mm and two types of barrels for each caliber.

Two versions of grip is available.

The 5.45x39 verison only have a 30-rd magazine and a extended 60-rd magazine.

Front side rails are accessible by removing the protective panel.

Installion:

Just like other mods. Unzip and drop Mass_JAK12 folder into “[Your EFT Directory]/user/mods”.

You should be able to find it and its parts in Mechanic’s shop and on the flea market.

Credits:
